feed.title: AI Science Tracker: additions and source checks

entry.title: Linux kernel SCTP chunk-padding buffer overflow
entry.summary: The Linux CNA documents insufficient room accounting for SCTP chunk padding, permitting an out-of-bounds write. It attributes the finding to LLM inspection and states that the behavior and fix were tested. (Vulnerability - Linux kernel contributors; announced 2026-11-20)

entry.title: Linux kernel pegasus receive-buffer corruption
entry.summary: The Linux CNA describes incorrect receive-buffer handling in the pegasus USB network driver that can lead to a kernel buffer panic. The source reports LLM-assisted code review followed by human reproduction with an emulated USB device. (Vulnerability - Linux kernel contributors; announced 2026-11-19)

entry.title: libtirpc UDP request-boundary data confusion (CVE-2026-104357)
entry.summary: Red Hat documents stale receive-buffer data being interpreted across UDP RPC requests, with limited cross-request disclosure or message confusion. The vendor does not establish arbitrary memory disclosure, code execution or demonstrated denial of service. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-19)

entry.title: Wireshark SCTP dissector heap-memory disclosure (CVE-2026-133624)
entry.summary: The maintainer reports heap-memory disclosure in the SCTP dissector and credits Khaled Suliman of AISLE Research. No downstream code-execution claim is inferred from the broader description on the discovery listing. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: Wireshark NBAP dissector crash (CVE-2026-130468)
entry.summary: The maintainer documents nbap dissector crash and credits Aisle Research. The advisory states it is unaware of exploits; this is not a guarantee that exploitation is impossible. Jaish Smael is separately credited with independent discovery. (Vulnerability - AISLE; announced 2026-11-18)

Researcher-reported code-execution demonstrations are distinct from the upstream severity label; no… (Vulnerability - Wiz Research; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.summary: HTTP/2 must be enabled; the vendor describes worker crashes, memory corruption and possible remote code execution subject to memory-protection conditions. NGINX lists upstream severity as major. Researcher-reported code-execution demonstrations are distinct from the upstream severity label; no… (Vulnerability - Wiz Research; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: NGINX HTTP/3 use-after-free (CVE-2026-121810)
entry.summary: The affected configuration enables HTTP/3 and forwards requests to an upstream server. NGINX lists upstream severity as medium. Researcher-reported code-execution demonstrations are distinct from the upstream severity label; no exploitation-in-the-wild finding is asserted here. (Vulnerability - Xint; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: NGINX mail-proxy use-after-free (CVE-2026-113425)
entry.summary: The affected configuration uses NGINX as a mail proxy, rather than an ordinary HTTP-only deployment. NGINX lists upstream severity as major. Researcher-reported code-execution demonstrations are distinct from the upstream severity label; no exploitation-in-the-wild finding is asserted here. (Vulnerability - Xint; announced 2026-11-18)

entry.title: Apache Shiro credential matching can bypass authentication in an empty-credential configuration
entry.summary: Apache Shiro credential matching can incorrectly accept authentication in configurations containing accounts with empty stored credentials. The vendor documents a fix in version 3.0.2. The Apache disclosure credits an LLM security scan with finding the issue and the Shiro team with validation and… (Vulnerability - Apache Software Foundation; Apache Shiro; announced 2026-11-14)

entry.title: Apache Shiro principal tags can expose applications to cross-site scripting
entry.summary: Apache Shiro principal tags can produce unescaped output when used with principal values that are not fully trusted. The affected Jakarta Pages and Jakarta Faces components are corrected in version 3.0.2. The original Apache disclosure credits Claude agents with finding the issue and the Shiro… (Vulnerability - Apache Software Foundation; Apache Shiro; announced 2026-11-14)

entry.title: Akaunting: Stored cross-site scripting in recurring invoice presentation
entry.summary: Akaunting 3.3.0 can expose a recurring-invoice reader to script execution through stored invoice data. A Manager account is required; the impact is limited to data and actions already accessible to the affected user. The individual advisory attributes detection to Fluid Attacks' AI SAST Scanner… (Vulnerability - Fluid Attacks; announced 2026-11-12)

entry.title: Akaunting: Stored cross-site scripting in imported invoice status
entry.summary: Akaunting 3.3.0 can expose another authenticated user to script execution through imported invoice status data. The source requires a Manager account and distinguishes the affected user's existing privileges from independent privilege escalation. entry.summary: XGBoost combined baseline MRI radiomics and clinical features to estimate muscle fat-fraction trajectory parameters in Duchenne muscular dystrophy. The final dataset included 98 unique participants, with 68 soleus and 64 vastus-lateralis analyses; held-out reconstructed trajectories had reported… (Discovery - University of Florida; announced 2026-11-11)

entry.summary: LimeSurvey 7.8.0 has an SQL-injection issue in survey archive processing and response export. It can expose database information to an authenticated user with survey-creation permission, subject to the application database account's access. The individual advisory attributes detection to Fluid… (Vulnerability - Fluid Attacks; announced 2026-11-10)

entry.summary: An authenticated user with participant-database import permission can expose a participant editor to script execution in LimeSurvey's participant-management interface. The source identifies version 7.7.0 as affected. The individual advisory attributes detection to Fluid Attacks' AI SAST Scanner… (Vulnerability - Fluid Attacks; announced 2026-11-09)

Development used 378 patients, with additional external and later-acquired validation cohorts of 45 and 50 patients. Patient grouping was retained during splits and… (Discovery - Sun Yat-Sen Memorial Hospital; announced 2026-11-08)

entry.title: Random forests nominate fungal taxa associated with leaf-warming samples
entry.summary: An exploratory random forest identified three fungal sequence variants associated with warmed versus control leaf samples across six Florida plant species. Kondoa and Zasmidium candidates had lower mean counts in warmed samples, while a Cystobasidiomycetes variant had higher counts. Overall… (Discovery - University of Miami; University of Toronto; University of Waikato; North Carolina State University; announced 2026-11-06)

entry.summary: HumHub Community Edition 1.19.0 can expose another authenticated user to script execution through its friendship-confirmation interface. The impact remains within the affected user's application permissions. The individual advisory attributes detection to Fluid Attacks' AI SAST Scanner and… (Vulnerability - Fluid Attacks; announced 2026-11-03)

entry.title: TGFBIp expression adds prognostic information in an ovarian-cancer ML study
entry.summary: In a retrospective tissue-microarray cohort of 155 epithelial ovarian-cancer patients, support vector machine and random forest models combined clinicopathological features with tumor and stromal TGFBIp expression. Adding both expression compartments improved held-out vital-status discrimination… (Discovery - Xuzhou Medical University; announced 2026-11-01)

entry.title: OpenEXR legacy Python channel out-of-bounds write
entry.summary: The upstream advisory documents an out-of-bounds write while decoding image channels through the legacy Python bindings. It explicitly attributes the finding to Anthropic using Claude and validation to an Ada Logics researcher; consequences depend on processing untrusted files. (Vulnerability - Anthropic; Ada Logics; OpenEXR; announced 2026-10-31)

entry.title: PHP stale-global-state use-after-free (CVE-2026-109619)
entry.summary: The PHP maintainer advisory documents stale global state that can cause a later request in the same worker to access freed request memory. The PHP Foundation reports a worker crash and researcher-demonstrated code execution in a real-world application. The October 21 advisory followed a limited… (Vulnerability - Wiz Research; announced 2026-10-21)

entry.title: Yopass retains encrypted files beyond expiry when uploads are disabled
entry.summary: When uploads are disabled, the advisory says the configured file store and expiry cleanup were not initialized, allowing existing encrypted blobs to remain beyond expiry. It explicitly states the blobs did not become available over HTTP; no unauthorized retrieval or stronger downstream consequence… (Vulnerability - Anthropic; Yopass; announced 2026-10-17)

entry.title: Pillow stale native storage across image-frame modes
entry.summary: The Pillow advisory describes multi-frame image loaders reusing stale native image storage after mode transitions, producing a memory-safety issue. The report credits AI-assisted analysis for discovery and verification support; downstream consequences depend on the processing environment and are… (Vulnerability - Pillow; rotemkama; announced 2026-10-17)

entry.title: GitPython identity-parser regular-expression denial of service
entry.summary: The GitPython advisory describes quadratic regular-expression backtracking while parsing malformed identity lines, allowing CPU exhaustion in applications processing untrusted repository metadata. The reporter explicitly states that Claude assisted the finding and that it was verified by hand. (Vulnerability - GitPython; Brian Willows; announced 2026-09-30)

entry.title: Explainable forests compare climate and extreme-weather malaria associations
entry.summary: A random forest analyzed malaria incidence across 78 countries during 2000–2022, with later years and withheld countries reserved for testing. Temperature and rainfall contributed more strongly to model predictions than disaster-related population indicators. These country-level observational… (Discovery - Begum Rokeya University; announced 2026-09-28)

entry.title: AsyncHttpClient caller cookie-header override
entry.summary: The advisory describes the cookie store overriding an explicitly supplied Cookie header, a separate path from the earlier CVE-2024-53990 correction. It states that AI-assisted tools supported discovery and analysis. (Vulnerability - AsyncHttpClient; 1diot9; announced 2026-09-24)

entry.title: AsyncHttpClient WebSocket decompression denial of service
entry.summary: The advisory describes unbounded WebSocket message decompression when compression is enabled, allowing resource exhaustion. This is distinct from the separately corrected HTTP decompression path; AI-assisted tools supported discovery and analysis. (Vulnerability - AsyncHttpClient; manus-pi; manus-use; announced 2026-09-24)

entry.title: AsyncHttpClient plaintext modification of Secure cookies
entry.summary: The advisory describes the cookie store accepting plaintext HTTP responses that can plant, overwrite or delete Secure cookies. It explicitly states that AI-assisted tools supported discovery and analysis. (Vulnerability - AsyncHttpClient; announced 2026-09-24)
